desc: Ruger and Magpul have over 100 years of combined experience designing and producing innovative, high-quality products in the firearms space. Magpul recently created a new grip - the EHG RG9 - for the new Ruger RXM, a 9mm NATO pistol made in the USA at Ruger's factory. The RXM is designed for personalization and customization for self-defense needs. The Ruger Fire Control Insert (FCI) is compatible with Magpul EHG RG9 grips.
